Danish Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Denmark comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Danish documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Borgerservice1250–4300 DKK
Driving Licencethe Borgerservice and Motorstyrelsen900–3400 DKK
ID Cardthe Borgerservice650–2100 DKK
Green CardSIRI2200–7200 DKK
Visaa Danish embassy1050–3600 DKK
Residence PermitSIRI2100–6200 DKK

Two checks specific to Denmark

  • Check the licence for the EU category grid and the Danish civil register reference.
  • Confirm the passport crown printing and the machine-readable zone.

Local red flag

  • A document where the final four digits of the civil register number are round numbers such as 0000.
